svg.title: Lab · full native dependency atlas
svg.desc: All 25 Lab nodes and their exact prerequisite edges, from five source feeds and CALC through CP1, directed review, CP2 and Integrity.
svg.text: 25 native nodes · 86 declared dependencies · arrows point to the consumer
Five feeds plus CALC → seed → six miners → Cross / Orient / Decide (CP1) → six directed miners → Cross / Director (CP2).
Integrity consumes both phases. Its 18 prerequisites span two continued panels; nothing is omitted.
Feed content is bound to the issue snapshot by runtime configuration, not by an extra JSON dependency edge.
TOOL: source or deterministic operation REASONING: model operator Green: frozen Lab/Oracle checkpoints
Repeated cards name the same artifact. Each declared edge appears once; no skip edges are omitted.
Research prototype. This is not financial advice.
